basic_info.description: Stunning Italianate Victorian in Hayes Valley.  Ideally located between Duboce Triangle, The Castro, and Eureka Valley, this beautifully preserved 2BD/1.5BA seamlessly blends timeless architectural detail with thoughtful modern updates. Including soaring ceilings, original moldings, wainscoting, natural-stained wood floors, and oversized bay windows that flood the home with light.   The elegant living room features an arched bay window, crown molding, and a ceiling medallion key elements of Italianate design.    A formal dining room with soaring ceilings, chair rail, and picture rail molding offers a refined setting for intimate dinner parties.   The vintage-inspired kitchen adds charm with mint green cabinetry, retro red accents, checkered floors, and a large window above the sink. A cozy breakfast nook overlooks the lush garden perfect for morning coffee or casual meals.      Two nice-sized bedrooms include a primary with double closets.   A spacious lower-level bonus room provides flexible use as an office, studio, or workshop.    The private garden offers a tranquil outdoor retreat. Other Features: 2-car tandem garage parking +driveway, and exceptional walkability to Duboce Park, shops, cafes, Bars, restaurants, Harvey Milk Center, and public transit. 99 Walk and Transit Scor
